title: 凯尔·罗达：美元走强与油价下跌的悖论——伊朗重返全球贸易
speaker: Kyle Roder

segments.en: For commodities potentially, for oil, I think there is one thing that is probably not being spoken about, spoken about enough over the last couple of weeks is obviously there's a lot of reasons why we're seeing this dollar strength.
segments.zh: 对于大宗商品，尤其是石油，过去几周有一个被低估的因素：美元走强背后有很多原因。

segments.en: A lot of it is to do with interest rate expectations, obviously, the US Fed versus the rest of the world, but I don't think it should be understated how significant it is that the United States is inviting Iran effectively back into global trade, selling its oil into global markets, and to do so it is going to have to do it with the US dollar and the US dollar payment system, which is, you know, a little bit of a reversal of that kind of de-dollarization trade, which was probably still in play from a structural point of view now, but certainly, you know, looking at last year and at the beginning of this year, you know, one of the reasons why we're seeing sort of dollar weakness.
segments.zh: 很大程度上与利率预期有关，即美联储与其他央行的差异。但不可忽视的是，美国正邀请伊朗重返全球贸易，用美元销售石油，这逆转了去美元化趋势，而去年和年初美元走弱的部分原因正是去美元化。

segments.en: So, you know, on the surface, this kind of dollar strength, you know, is something that is contributing to a weaker oil price, that if it persists, it will obviously add to, you know, a weaker oil price. I guess the irony there is that, you know, the weaker oil price has very much been driven by these expectations of Iranian supply hitting the markets, and it's also something incidentally that is boosted in the dollar again because of that kind of unwind of the de-dollarization trade.
segments.zh: 表面上看，美元走强导致油价下跌，如果持续，将进一步压低油价。讽刺的是，油价下跌很大程度上源于伊朗供应增加的预期，而这又因去美元化交易的逆转进一步推升了美元。
